name: HCPDHealthcareServiceLocationSearchTrack2
title: HCPD: search HealthcareService by location (Track 2 in-cluster directory)
description: Track 2 adaptation of the Sparked 2026-07-08 Scenario 1 / Step 1 test. Runs against OUR in-cluster HCPD directory server (HAPI, seeded via deploy/seed/hcpd-balmain.json), not the public HCPD sandbox. Differences from the Sparked original: (1) our HAPI serves /metadata and does not require the X-Request-ID header, so the hcpd-proxy sidecar is NOT needed; (2) fhir.server.url points at the directory server (e.g. http://directory:8080/fhir in-cluster, or the port-forward). Exercises Step 1 goal (a): searching for health care services in a location.

operation.description: Search HealthcareService by location.address-city=Balmain against the seeded in-cluster directory.

test.name: HealthcareService search returns at least one match in Balmain
